strapiBlog.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine star Terry Crews Buys a Home at Binghatti Aquarise
strapiBlog.short_description: In a landmark event that underscores the global allure of Dubai's luxury real estate market, Hollywood actor and television personality Terry Crews has officially acquired a residence at Binghatti Aquarise.

data.text:
In a landmark event that underscores the global allure of Dubai's luxury real estate market, Hollywood actor and television personality Terry Crews has officially acquired a residence at Binghatti Aquarise. The announcement was made during the grand launch of the project, which Crews hosted at the Coca-Cola Arena on May 7, 2025. This high-profile acquisition not only highlights the project's architectural brilliance but also positions Binghatti Aquarise as a premier destination for discerning investors and homeowners.

A Grand Unveiling at the Coca-Cola Arena

The launch event at the Coca-Cola Arena was a spectacle of grandeur, attracting over 12,000 attendees, including VIP investors, top brokers, and representatives from leading global firms. Terry Crews, renowned for his role in Brooklyn Nine-Nine, served as the exclusive host, bringing his signature energy and charisma to the stage. During the event, Crews unveiled a live video feed from the Binghatti Aquarise construction site, marking the official commencement of the project's development, which is scheduled for completion by March 2027.

Muhammad Binghatti, Chairman of Binghatti, expressed his enthusiasm about welcoming Crews to the community of homeowners, stating that this milestone reflects the rising confidence in Binghatti’s visionary developments and further cements Dubai’s status as a premier global hub for luxury living and real estate investment.

Binghatti Aquarise: Luxury Living in Business Bay

Binghatti Aquarise at Business Bay is set to become a striking architectural landmark in Dubai. Featuring 1,598 upscale units—including studios, 1- to 4-bedroom residences, and exclusive royal suites—the development redefines resort-style living through a seamless blend of luxury and innovation.

Key amenities include a 27,000+ square foot artificial beach, a design-led oval indoor gym, and a 44-meter infinity pool offering panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa. Its central location ensures effortless access to major destinations across the city, enhancing both lifestyle and convenience.

With a flexible 70/30 payment plan, Binghatti Aquarise offers a strategic opportunity for those seeking premium real estate in one of Dubai’s most prestigious districts.
